nodes.name: Integration Testing.md
nodes.summary: Qoder wiki page describing how to set up and run integration tests for the Setura Hospital OS against a local Supabase stack, covering database initialization, service configuration, environment setup, and testing strategies for API endpoints, edge functions, webhooks, background jobs, queues, payments, and external integrations.

nodes.name: Mocking Strategies.md
nodes.summary: Qoder wiki page explaining the mocking strategies used across Setura Hospital OS to test external services (WhatsApp API, payment gateways), database operations, authentication, and third-party integrations without a general-purpose mocking framework.

nodes.name: Test Infrastructure.md
nodes.summary: Qoder wiki page covering the test infrastructure for Setura Hospital OS, including test configuration, environment variable management, seed data generation, integration test interaction with a local Supabase stack, and CI execution of automated testing.

nodes.name: Testing Strategy.md
nodes.summary: Qoder wiki page defining the testing strategy for Setura Hospital OS using a testing pyramid: unit tests, integration tests against a local Supabase stack, and end-to-end scenarios for critical user workflows, with guidance for edge functions, background jobs, and performance testing.

nodes.name: Unit Testing.md
nodes.summary: Qoder wiki page explaining the unit testing approach for Setura Hospital OS using Deno's built-in test runner, covering patterns for error handling, response formatting, input validation, async operations, and edge function unit tests.
